entries.pattern: Water molecule starting at atom \d+ can not be settled
entries.cause: Overlaps after build, a bad energy minimization, or a time step that is too large
entries.hint: Re-run EM with emtol = 100; if it recurs, use dt = 0.001.

entries.cause: Constraint failures from overlaps or a large time step (systems with LINCS)
entries.hint: Re-run EM with emtol = 100; if it recurs, use dt = 0.001.

entries.cause: The simulation blew up (NaN or Inf in the energies)
entries.hint: Same remedy as the SETTLE failure: tighter EM, then a smaller time step.

entries.pattern: did not converge to Fmax|Energy minimization reached the maximum number of steps
entries.cause: Too few EM steps for the starting configuration

entries.pattern: forces have not converged to the requested precision
entries.cause: EM stopped at machine precision before reaching the requested emtol
entries.hint: Show the final Fmax. A looser emtol changes the protocol, so it needs a plan edit and a new approval.

entries.pattern: number of coordinates in coordinate file .* does not match topology
entries.cause: The molecule count in the coordinates and the topology differ
entries.hint: Rebuild with build_water_box, then set_plan and a new approval.

entries.pattern: No such moleculetype SOL|Atomtype .* not found|Unknown (residue|atom ?type)
entries.cause: The topology is missing or has the wrong include
entries.hint: Regenerate the topology from the force-field choice, then set_plan and a new approval.

entries.cause: GROMACS could not find its data directory
entries.hint: Run gmx_check_environment and show GMXDATA and GMXLIB.

entries.pattern: longer than half the shortest box vector|cut-off length is longer
entries.cause: The box is too small for the cut-offs
entries.hint: Offer a larger system or a smaller cut-off; both change the system or the method.

entries.cause: grompp flagged a real setup issue
entries.hint: Show each warning with its id and ask for a decision; -maxwarn only through an acknowledgement.

entries.pattern: domain decomposition|too many ranks|cannot be partitioned
entries.cause: The rank count is unsuitable for about 4,000 atoms
entries.hint: Show the cause and set gmx.ntmpi in the configuration (auto already means 1 rank below 10,000 atoms).

entries.cause: A problem with the binary or the environment

entries.pattern: Out of memory|No space left on device
entries.cause: The host ran out of memory or disk
The mdrun process was killed or lost

entries.hint: Show the log excerpt, mark the confidence as low, and ask the researcher.
